# 00000000637

**English.** Definition: The center Z(P_n) of the pure braid group. Conjecture: For n ≥ 3, Z(P_n) is generated by the square of the full twist, and the stable commutator length of P_n/Z is bounded (combining the center with scl).

**中文。** 定义：纯辫中心 Z(P_n)。猜想：P_n 的中心由全 twist 的平方生成(n ≥ 3),且商 P_n/Z 的稳定交换子长度有界(中心与 scl 的组合)。
